title: Purple/Yellow Rosinante
summary: A Trafalgar Law deck. Your Leader makes Law cheaper to play and saves Law from being K.O.'d by taking a Life card instead. You fill the table with Blockers and control the game with DON!! minus effects.
gamePlan: Early turns: Koby and Marineford find Navy cards, and Donquixote Rosinante (OP12-108) finds Trafalgar Law.
Use the Leader's Activate effect (return 1 DON!!) to play a 4-cost Law for 2 less. P-093 Law gives you a DON!! back when you're behind on DON!!.
Build a wall: most of your Laws, Rosinante & Law and Borsalino have [Blocker]. When a Law would be K.O.'d, your Leader lets you take a Life card instead (once per turn).
Sakazuki gives an opposing Character -6000 power until the end of their next turn. Mamaragan rests a Character and draws.
DON!! minus (DON!! -1) means returning DON!! from your field to your DON!! deck. Count your DON!! before your big turn.

keyCards.why: Leader. Makes Law 2 cheaper, and saves Law from a K.O. once per turn.
Trafalgar Law. 6000 [Blocker] that gives you a DON!! when you're behind.
Rosinante & Law. Counts as Law. 8000 power [Blocker].
Borsalino. [Blocker] that adds a Life card when you're at 2 or less.
Sakazuki. -6000 power to a Character for a whole round.
I Love You!! 1-cost +2000 Counter that can return a Law from trash.

howItWins: Defense first. You block and counter everything, keep your Laws alive, and attack once your opponent runs out of cards.
weakTo: Decks that rest or move your Blockers before attacking.
Effects that stop Blockers or remove Characters without K.O.ing them (your Leader only stops K.O.s).
mulliganTips: Keep a Law, a searcher (Koby, Marineford or Rosinante) and a Counter Event.
